facts.text: Harrisburg University requires all undergraduates to gain real-world practical experience by completing both an applied research project and an internship in their field.

sources.title: National Intern Day 2025: How HU Students Are Making an Impact Across Industries
sources.quote: At HU, every student gains real-world experience through both applied research and an internship in their field, giving graduates a competitive edge in high-growth fields like advanced manufacturing, forensics, healthcare, and more.
